text: 金十数据10月20日讯，财政部拟发行2026年记账式贴现（六十八期）国债。本期国债为期限182天的贴现债。本期国债竞争性招标面值总额550亿元，进行甲类成员追加投标。本期国债发行价格通过竞争性招标确定，以低于票面金额的价格贴现发行。本期国债自2026年10月28日开始计息，于2027年4月28日（节假日顺延）按面值偿还。招标时间2026年10月27日上午10:35至11:35。
text_en: Jinshi Data, October 20: The Ministry of Finance plans to issue 2026 book-entry discount (68th issue) government bonds. This issue is a 182-day discount bond. The total face value of the competitive tender for this issue is 55 billion yuan, with additional bidding by Class A members. The issue price will be determined through competitive tender and issued at a discount below par. Interest on this issue will begin accruing on October 28, 2026, and it will be redeemed at par on April 28, 2027 (postponed for holidays). The tender time is from 10:35 to 11:35 a.m. on October 27, 2026.
